title: Content Brief
description: Output contract of CONTENT-BRIEF.md (module 03, PLAN phase) and the pre-generation contract handed to the content-style skill as source_material. The brief synthesizes intent (embedded intent-analysis object), keywords, SERP-derived gaps, outline, required subtopics, information-gain opportunities, links, media, schema type, and snippet opportunities into the single document the WRITE and VALIDATE phases judge the article against. Data Availability Policy: fields whose source data was not provided (content_gaps without real SERP data, internal_link_opportunities without inventory) are left empty and the absence is recorded in data_availability and keyword_metrics; never fabricated.

topic.description: The article's topic as promoted by the CMS.

intent_summary.description: The full intent-analysis object from SEARCH-INTENT.md, embedded verbatim.

primary_keyword.description: Exactly one primary keyword, identical to the keyword map's.

secondary_keywords.description: Supporting-angle keyword phrasings carried over from the keyword map.

semantic_entities.description: Entities (named things search engines recognize) the article should name unambiguously through natural coverage.

user_questions.description: Natural-language questions the article must answer; sourced from the keyword map and, when available, real SERP-visible questions.

h1_recommendation.description: Recommended H1: aligned with the primary keyword and main question, phrased for the arriving reader.

level.description: Heading level in the planned hierarchy.

purpose.description: What this section must accomplish for the reader, including depth notes for deliberately short treatments.

required.description: True when the brief requires this section in the output; optional sections may be cut without a missing_subtopic issue.

outline.description: The planned H2/H3 structure; the first section must answer the intent's main question.

required_subtopics.description: Subtopics the article must cover with useful treatment; each may carry a depth note (e.g. 'short treatment acceptable'). Feeds checks SEO-V03/V04.

content_gaps.description: Topics the real SERP's top results collectively miss. MUST stay empty when serp_data is false; never fabricate competitor findings to fill it.

information_gain_opportunities.description: What the article will offer beyond the obvious: specifics, comparisons, decision criteria, unanswered subtopics. Feeds INFORMATION-GAIN.md.

target_url.description: URL or slug of a real page from the CMS inventory; never an invented URL.

anchor_suggestion.description: Natural anchor phrasing a reader would expect on the link.

reason.description: Why this link serves the reader of this article.

internal_link_opportunities.description: Inventory-driven internal link candidates; empty when the CMS inventory is UNAVAILABLE.

description.description: What the media must show to serve comprehension.

placement.description: Where in the article the media belongs, near the text it supports.

alt_text_suggestion.description: Alt text describing the actual image; never a keyword container.

recommended_media.description: Media the article genuinely needs, with placement and honest alt-text suggestions.

schema_type.description: The structured data type matching the article's visible content; 'none' when no type honestly applies.

serp_feature_opportunities.description: SERP feature opportunities the planned content genuinely supports; only types observed in real SERP data (or clearly adjacent to it).

keyword_metrics.description: Status of the keyword metrics carried into the brief from the keyword map. Same policy as the keyword map: every field is either a real number from a real integration (source recorded in metrics_sources) or the exact string UNAVAILABLE; never invented or estimated.

search_volume.description: Search volume. Number only when received from a real integration; otherwise exactly "UNAVAILABLE".

keyword_difficulty.description: Keyword difficulty. Number only when received from a real integration; otherwise exactly "UNAVAILABLE".

cpc.description: Cost per click. Number only when received from a real integration; otherwise exactly "UNAVAILABLE".

competition.description: Competition level. Number only when received from a real integration; otherwise exactly "UNAVAILABLE".

ranking.description: Current ranking position. Number only when received from a real integration (e.g. Search Console); otherwise exactly "UNAVAILABLE".

traffic_estimate.description: Estimated traffic. Number only when received from a real integration; otherwise exactly "UNAVAILABLE".

metrics_sources.description: Map of metric name to the real source that supplied it. Omit when every metric is UNAVAILABLE.

serp_data.description: True only when real SERP data was provided and analyzed.

cms_inventory.description: True only when the CMS inventory was provided (internal link opportunities depend on it).

search_console.description: True only when real Search Console data was provided.

notes.description: What was unavailable and how the brief compensated (intent + keyword reasoning, lower confidence) — the honest record of what this brief rests on.

data_availability.description: Which real inputs the brief was built on; UNAVAILABLE inputs produce honestly empty fields, never fabricated ones.

brief_version.description: Version of this brief; regenerate (do not silently mutate) on scope change.
